limits: Every case has two F/R process observations, each median uses6 nested traces; forward segmentation is reported separately; no CI claim.
Actual model profile derives B separately; model weights are not resident during timed replay.
Repeated/rotated captured BF16 KV forms synthetic32K histories, not independent fresh model sessions.
Whole trace includes policy, pinned H2D restore and48layer attention read, not encoding or serving.
GPU hit rates refer to whole-session HBM LRU; all host histories are retained without a host capacity cap.
H2D total includes payload plus restore/read metadata; payload and metadata remain separate in JSON.
Pair ordering changes only bracket tested W points; no continuous crossover is inferred.
All slower-than-Raw medians are retained, including small differences with no significance assessment.
